english_title: Quantitative Version of the Second Borel-Cantelli Lemma
statement_en: Let $E_1,E_2,\dots \in\mathcal{F}$ satisfy the condition that there exists a positive real number $C$ such that $$\sum_{i,j\leq N}\mathbb{P}(E_i \cap E_j)\leq C \left(\sum_{i\leq N}\mathbb{P}(E_i)\right)^2$$ for infinitely many positive integers $N$, and suppose also that $$\sum_{n\geq 1}\mathbb{P}(E_n)=\infty.$$ Then $$\mathbb{P}(\limsup_{n\to\infty}E_n)\geq \frac{1}{C}.$$
callout_body:
集合列$E_1,..,E_n,..\in\mathcal{F}$满足存在一个正实数$C$使得$$\sum_{i,j\leq N}\mathbb{P}(E_i \cap E_j)\leq C \left(\sum_{i\leq N}\mathbb{P}(E_i)\right)^2$$对无穷多个正整数$N$成立，并且其测度形成的集合不收敛$$\sum_{n\geq 1}\mathbb{P}(E_n)=\infty$$
那么$$\mathbb{P}(\limsup_{n\to\infty}E_n)\geq \frac{1}{C}$$
